_purpose: Durable record of the account holder's real, explicit, per-category approval that the listing_evidence.py signing tool (scripts/sign_listing_evidence.py) mechanically re-applies on each run. This is a STANDING decision the holder already made - the script re-signs fresh content hashes against this same decision, it does not ask a new question each run and does not invent new approval.
approval_channel: Telegram chat with Hermes agent, explicit clarify confirmations
scope: home storage/organization product family (Aufbewahrung/Organizer) only - low-risk, non-electronic/battery/toy/cosmetic/children's-product categories, matching the existing risk gates

dispatch_origin.note: REVISED 2026-11-16: no API field exposes ship-from country directly. Real basis = service_name/logistics_service_name signal (CAINIAO_FULFILLMENT_STD = China-origin Cainiao network, verified across all checked products). Records CN only on that match; anything else is flagged origin_requires_manual_check, never guessed. Re-confirmed by account holder after this correction.

revocation: If the account holder withdraws this approval, delete/replace this file and re-run scripts/sign_listing_evidence.py --revoke (or simply stop running the signing script); existing signed records will still expire naturally within 24h per listing_evidence.MAX_AGE.
